findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: yacht-charter-cost-calculator, flight-arrival-time-calculator, hotel-upsell-revenue-calculator, luxury-packing-list · Private data: experience-pricing-calculator, yacht-crew-tip-calculator, private-jet-vs-first-class-calculator, private-staff-day-rate-calculator, luxury-travel-carbon-calculator, luxury-packing-list · Public sink: toms-vat-calculator, luxury-trip-budget-estimator, travel-agent-commission-calculator, revpar-calculator, group-trip-cost-splitter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: yacht-charter-cost-calculator, flight-arrival-time-calculator, hotel-upsell-revenue-calculator, luxury-packing-list · Private data: experience-pricing-calculator, yacht-crew-tip-calculator, private-jet-vs-first-class-calculator, private-staff-day-rate-calculator, luxury-travel-carbon-calculator, luxury-packing-list · Public sink: toms-vat-calculator, luxury-trip-budget-estimator, travel-agent-commission-calculator, revpar-calculator, group-trip-cost-splitter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
